attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OpenWrt router) to route between lan-a (node2, eth1, 192.168.10.0/24) and lan-b (node3, eth1, 192.168.20.0/24), each previously-unconfigured NIC brought up with a static IP. Added firewall4 zones lan_a/lan_b (forward=REJECT default) plus a single explicit rule permitting only TCP/5432 from lan_a to lan_b; removed an initial mistake (blanket 'config forwarding' sections that unconditionally accepted all traffic) once discovered via nft ruleset inspection. Also had to open a source-scoped firewalld rich-rule on node3 (192.168.10.0/24 -> tcp/5432 only) since AlmaLinux's host firewall was independently blocking the port. Verified: node2->node3:5432 succeeds; node2->node3 other ports and ping refused; node3->node2 (any port/ping) refused — satisfying the bidirectional 'refuse everything else' requirement. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (boot_id changed on each, confirming true reboots), and post-restart the persisted UCI/network/firewalld config and functional TCP/5432-only policy were re-verified end to end.
